name: Compound v2 UNI oracle guard stale-price bad debt
summary: Compound's immutable UniswapAnchoredView accepted Chainlink UNI updates only while they stayed within 15% of a 30-minute Uniswap v3 TWAP. A genuine rapid UNI rally moved the reporter outside that band, so validate() emitted PriceGuarded and retained the stale $8.34 price. The actor supplied stablecoin collateral, borrowed 232,890.987 UNI at that valuation across six transactions, and sold it at the higher market price; liquidations exhausted the collateral and left 28,699.848 UNI of bad debt.

loss.notes: The final liquidation transaction records accountBorrows of exactly 28,699.848014519304045859 UNI after the six campaign borrows and all economically useful collateral seizures. The borrower retains no cUNI and only non-economic cUSDC and cDAI dust. The quantity is valued at the $10.381361 UNI price accepted onchain by UniswapAnchoredView 24 seconds before that liquidation; subsequent interest and unrelated same-window borrower campaigns are excluded.

ageReset.description: Compound Proposal 143 changed the Comptroller oracle pointer from 0x65c816077c29b557bee980ae3cc2dce80204a0c5 to this UniswapAnchoredView. No later NewPriceOracle or failover event occurs before the exploit, and the artifact runtime hash remains unchanged.

sources.note: The anchor is the first of six successful transactions from EOA 0xe000008459b74a91e306a47c808061dfa372000e to borrower 0x2f99fb66ea797e7fa2d07262402ab38bd5e53b12. Its call trace reaches cUNI, the Comptroller and UniswapAnchoredView, whose getUnderlyingPrice(cUNI) returns the stored $8.34 price; all six transactions supply stablecoin collateral, borrow UNI and sell UNI on market. Immediately before the campaign, the first UNI PriceGuarded event is transaction 0xba0f7e4a1a38475989a1e325073c7099608722fb3d6edb24958a6467a8e17a50 at block 19290889:31: the reporter is $8.617324 while the 30-minute anchor is $7.319215, just outside the immutable 85%-115% band, so the last accepted $8.34 price remains stored while UNI rallies. The six Borrow events leave accountBorrows of 232,890.987234064080019806 UNI. Four later liquidations seize the useful collateral; the last, 0xbc2f51cdf71b8654a3493f368a20ad8b25f0c670f012c1e841c5fe20d5776fb0 at 19290991:0, emits RepayBorrow with accountBorrows 28,699.848014519304045859 UNI. At that block the borrower has zero cUNI and only 7,280 raw cUSDC plus 5,043,870,237 raw cDAI, non-economic dust. Transaction 0x36549474d89cdbeabfdfc6d0fc0d13a1da5bffa8973403d905b8bb09490af544 accepted a $10.381361 UNI price at timestamp 1708699751, the price still stored immediately before the final liquidation, valuing the residual debt at $297,943.48288385815. The oracle is a direct contract deployed at 15640902:2, timestamp 1664477507; its runtime hash 0x6073f62eef16ba34ad127def4c68782b43edd58605066c5c02cfa66da2c526df is identical at deployment and pre-exploit. Constructor state fixes anchorPeriod=1,800 seconds and bounds at 0.85 and 1.15. Proposal 143 execution 0x93d3c9556b2695031fd68b467af90d385cfc8637466ba6ceb810a9b7ecdf8249 emitted NewPriceOracle at log 34, moving the Comptroller pointer from 0x65c816077c29b557bee980ae3cc2dce80204a0c5 to the target at timestamp 1673959715. It is the only NewPriceOracle event through the exploit and there is no FailoverActivated or FailoverDeactivated event, so activation is the last age reset and code age is 34,739,220 seconds. Three other borrower addresses used the same stale window but are independent EOAs and execution contexts; they are excluded from this campaign's loss rather than merged into one actor.
